notes.title: BYTE is in Tiny Teams this week!
notes.notes: [p]Today marks the start of this year's Tiny Teams showcase! Tiny Teams is an annual Steam event/showcase to highlight games made by solo developers and small teams, and [i]BYTE[/i] is featured this year's edition. :)[/p][p][i]BYTE[/i] is currently in the Steam event, which you can check out here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025[/url][/p][p][i]BYTE[/i] will also be live-streamed on the Yogscast YouTube and Twitch channels, in addition to the Tiny Teams Steam page on Saturday between 5pm and 8pm BST![/p][p]Tiny Teams will be streaming games from the showcase all week, so don't forget to check out the other games as well. You can find the streams here:[/p][list][*][p][url="http://twitch.tv/yogscast"]http://twitch.tv/yogscast[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@yogscast"]https://www.youtube.com/@yogscast[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]To celebrate the start of Tiny Teams and continue my ramp up to releasing [i]BYTE[/i] fully, I have just put out a new version of the demo (likely my last update before the release) that features a handful of fixes and a coupe of new features.[/p][h3]Hot New Music[/h3][p]After two years, [i]BYTE[/i] finally has more music! Five new tracks have been into the game and are interspersed throughout the demo. In addition to two new combat tracks, there are two new ambient tracks and a new substory/cutscene track. Play through the demo to hear it all![/p][h3]Resolution Settings[/h3][p]Since the demo's initial release, [i]BYTE[/i]'s resolution has been automatically determined by the game, setting the output resolution to closest the game can get to your monitor's resolution and then halving the resolution if your monitor's is high enough.[/p][p]In the interest of usability, readability, and fun, you can now manually override the in-game resolution! Aside from being able to change the game's render resolution, you can also manually enable/disable the half-resing, so you can customize the look of [i]BYTE[/i]'s rendering to suit your tastes.[/p][p]Keep an eye out for more [i]BYTE[/i] updates and don't forget to stay tuned for the full release on October 1st, 2025![/p]

notes.title: BYTE Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Release Date![/b][/h3][p]It’s Steam Next Fest, which means that over here (in my apartment) it’s time to celebrate![/p][p][/p][p]The days tick by and my deadline to release [i]BYTE[/i] draws closer but luckily I’m [i]right on track[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]To kick off Steam Next Fest I’m thrilled to announce that the official release date for [i]BYTE[/i] will be October 1st, 2025![/p][p][/p][p]Believe it or not, I’ve been targeting an October 6th release day for about a year and a half at this point, but development of [i]BYTE[/i] is so on track that I decided to move it up a few days so I can start Halloween month with a bang.[/p][p][/p][p]The first five weeks of [i]BYTE[/i] are all that have been publicly available from the game for somewhere in the ballpark of [i]19 months[/i] at this point, so suffice it to say that I am [u][i][b]beyond excited[/b][/i][/u] to finally show the world the rest of this game.[/p][p][/p][p]Despite showing everyone these first five weeks, I truly believe that [i]BYTE[/i] only gets better as the days roll on, so wishlist the game now and stay tuned for that final release on October 1st![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984738/9b6c47e8cd95ccf6dac142d920827ef411faa5a9.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Next Fest (and FMV)![/b][/h3][p]As I mentioned, [i]BYTE[/i] is in Steam Next Fest right now, which also means that a new demo is available.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo contains the same five weeks and core content as the previous version, but to coincide with this announcement, I just pushed a minor update to the demo that adds in some [b]full-motion video[/b] that I recorded recently.[/p][p][/p][p]I use the FMV to add more flavor into the diorama scenes that I added in the previous update and to replace the cutscenes that were currently still images (just the intro scene in the demo).[/p][p][/p][p]The video was all shot [i]on location[/i] in various parts of Oregon (mostly Portland), so rest-assured, you’re getting an authentic Oregonian experience :).[/p][p][/p][p]Aside from that, some other minor changes have been implemented including a redesign of some of the battle arenas and general bug fixes.[/p][p]
Stay tuned for more updates on [i]BYTE[/i] and happy Next Fest![/p]

notes.title: BYTE Demo Update!
notes.notes:
The [i]BYTE[/i] Demo just got its first update!

As work continues on [i]BYTE[/i], I just pushed a new update to showcase a couple of the recent additions that I have finished up. These are the new things to check out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984738/9e8d85fb8c528e792e762c0d7e8f9db5ace86973.png[/img]

[h3]Cutscenes[/h3]
As part of a push to make [i]BYTE[/i]'s cutscenes more cinematic and engaging, all major scenes in the game utilize the camera angle system that was previously on display in just a few core scenes. Additionally, the camera system has been built out to allow for more kinds of camera shots as well!

For the journal cutscenes, there is now a new "diorama" system that provides 3D artwork instead of just the plain image that was used before. This new system is on display in the scene at the end of July 7th and the final scene in the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984738/824f0cc3c7b4573b03c96f8365c599c6425936e8.png[/img]

[h3]Exercise[/h3]
Exercise is important for everyone, including realtors! Now in the Solarium is a yoga mat that Jonathan can use to work out. Doing so increases his max MP, introducing more MP management into the game.

[h3]Dream Journals[/h3]
A second "Lucy's Dream Journal" sequence was added towards the end of the demo. This continues the story from the first Dream Sequence and introduces new a new character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984738/d1baea63fbee6a2d6d6dc32080c11f6ea3aa0a5e.png[/img]
